district.name: Chikkamagaluru
district.description: The birthplace of Indian coffee, Chikkamagaluru features Karnataka's highest peak Mullayanagiri (1,930m), Kudremukh National Park, sacred Sringeri Sharada Peetha, Baba Budangiri, and cascading Hebbe Falls.
district.descriptionKannada: ಕಾಫಿಯ ತವರು ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರು, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅತಿ ಎತ್ತರದ ಶಿಖರ ಮುಳ್ಳಯ್ಯನಗಿರಿ, ಕುದುರೆಮುಖ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಉದ್ಯಾನ, ಪವಿತ್ರ ಶೃಂಗೇರಿ ಶಾರದಾ ಪೀಠ, ಬಾಬಾಬುಡನ್‌ಗಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹೆಬ್ಬೆ ಜಲಪಾತಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.

destinations.name: Mullayanagiri Peak (Karnataka's Highest Point)
destinations.description: The highest mountain peak in Karnataka, standing majestic at 1,930 meters (6,330 feet) in the Chandra Drona hill range of the Western Ghats. Features the ancient sage Mullappa Swamy cave temple on the wind-swept summit, blankets of mist, and 360-degree panoramic views of coffee estates and rugged shola valleys.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Named after sage Mullappa Swamy who meditated inside a natural cave atop the summit; celebrated in local lore for thousands of years.
destinations.culturalImportance: The ultimate trekking conquest in Karnataka, famous for the magical experience of watching swirling cloud formations roll over mountain ridges.
destinations.bestSeason: September to March (Winter offers clear blue skies; monsoon provides dramatic mist)
destinations.nearestRailwayStation: Chikkamagaluru Railway Station (24 km) or Kadur (60 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Narrow single-lane mountain ghat road to base parking, followed by ~500 stone stairs to peak
destinations.trekkingDifficulty: Moderate (500 stone steps with handrails from parking; windy summit)
destinations.safetyInstructions: Road can be congested during weekends; travel early morning. Strong mountain winds at the summit; hold onto handrails. Carry a light windbreaker jacket.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Open mountain destination; traffic regulated by district police during peak holiday weekends

destinations.name: Kudremukh Peak & National Park
destinations.description: A pristine 1,894-meter mountain peak whose silhouette resembles the face of a horse ('Kudre-mukha'), situated in the heart of a 600 sq km UNESCO World Heritage rainforest and shola-grassland national park. Shelters endangered lion-tailed macaques, tigers, leopards, and great pied hornbills.
destinations.historicalSignificance: One of the finest biodiversity conservation success stories in India; open-cast iron ore mining was halted by the Supreme Court of India in 2005 to restore the pristine catchment of Tunga, Bhadra, and Netravathi rivers.
destinations.culturalImportance: A sacred environmental haven for nature purists, with strict daily trek quotas via the Aranya online permit portal.

photos.caption: Kudremukh Peak & National Park
photos.source: Karnataka Forest Department & UNESCO World Heritage Centre

destinations.bestSeason: October to February (Lush green rolling hills and clear weather)
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 15 km from Kalasa, 95 km from Chikkamagaluru
destinations.nearestRailwayStation: Mangaluru Junction (110 km) or Mudigere (60 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved road to Balagal/Kalasa, followed by 4WD jeep trail to Mullodi base camp
destinations.trekkingDifficulty: Challenging (22 km round-trip trek across rolling grasslands)
destinations.safetyInstructions: Mandatory advance booking on Aranya portal. Daily quota restricted to 50 trekkers. Leeches common post-monsoon; carry salt and leech gaiters. Strictly zero plastic allowed.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Online permit via Karnataka Forest Department (Aranya portal) mandatory
destinations.tourismInformationSource: Karnataka Forest Department & UNESCO World Heritage Centre

destinations.name: Sringeri Sharada Peetha & Vidyashankara Temple
destinations.nameKannada: ಶೃಂಗೇರಿ ಶಾರದಾ ಪೀಠ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾಶಂಕರ ದೇವಾಲಯ
destinations.description: The southern cardinal monastic seat (Dakshinamnaya Sharada Peetha) established in the 8th century CE by Adi Shankaracharya on the sacred banks of the Tunga River. Features the breathtaking 14th-century Vidyashankara Temple, an architectural fusion of Hoysala and Dravidian styles boasting 12 astronomical zodiac pillars (Rashi Stambhas) illuminated by the morning sun in seasonal sequence.
destinations.historicalSignificance: The first and foremost of the four Advaita Peethas founded by Adi Shankara; patronized by Vijayanagara founders Hakka and Bukka under Saint Vidyaranya.
destinations.culturalImportance: Venerated worldwide as the supreme seat of Sanatana Dharma philosophy and classical Sanskrit scholarship.

photos.caption: Sringeri Sharada Peetha & Vidyashankara Temple
photos.source: Sri Sringeri Sharada Peetham & Karnataka Tourism

destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 85 km from Chikkamagaluru, 105 km from Mangaluru
destinations.nearestRailwayStation: Udupi Railway Station (85 km) or Shivamogga (95 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved scenic ghat road through thick rainforests of Western Ghats
destinations.safetyInstructions: Feeding the large sacred fish (Tor Khudree) in the Tunga river ghat with puffed rice is a sacred tradition. Remove shoes at entrance.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Managed by Sri Sringeri Sharada Peetham; open to all
